agreeTermsDetail:
Article 1 (Purpose)
These Terms of Service (the 'Terms') govern the relationship between 'Dibs Adventure' (the 'Company' or 'Service') and the player (the 'Player' or 'Member') regarding the use of the mobile location-based game service and all related services provided by the Company.

Article 2 (Effect and Amendment of Terms)
1. These Terms shall become effective upon the Player agreeing to them during sign-up. The Company shall post the Terms on the game service start screen or official website.
2. The Company may amend these Terms to the extent that it does not violate relevant laws.
3. In the event of an amendment, the Company will announce it 7 days prior (30 days for unfavorable or significant changes) to the effective date via in-game notices or the website. Players who continue to use the Service after the effective date shall be deemed to have accepted the amended Terms. Players who disagree may terminate the agreement through account deletion.

Article 3 (Rules Outside the Terms)
Matters not specified in these Terms and the interpretation thereof shall be governed by the standard terms and conditions for mobile games, the Act on the Protection and Use of Location Information, the Personal Information Protection Act, other relevant laws, or commercial practices.

Article 4 (Formation of Agreement and Application)
1. The agreement is formed when the Player agrees to these Terms and the Privacy Policy, applies for account creation, and the Company approves it.
2. Applicants must link their own unique device identifier (UUID) or external authentication platforms (Google, Apple, etc.) to provide accurate registration information. Players who steal others' information or register false information cannot claim any rights under these Terms, and the Company may terminate the agreement or cancel the registration.
3. In principle, registration is not allowed for children under the age of 14, and may only be approved in exceptional cases with the consent of a legal representative.

Article 5 (Protection and Management of Personal Information)
1. The Company strives to protect the Player's personal information in accordance with relevant laws, and the separate Privacy Policy shall apply to the protection and use of personal information.
2. Due to the nature of the Service, information set to be public (such as nicknames and captured territory status) may be disclosed to other players to facilitate smooth interactions.

Article 6 (Contents and Use of Location-based Services)
The location-based services provided by the Company are as follows, and are processed by receiving the Player's real-time GPS coordinate data and network base station location information:
1. Real-time territory capture: A service that calculates latitude/longitude coordinates and records them as the Player's territory when the Player enters a specific hexagon (H3 grid) area with a mobile device.
2. Distance-based resource calculation and HQ setup: A service that calculates the straight-line distance from the Player's designated HQ coordinates to adjust the accumulation speed of in-game virtual gold (GP) and control the range of remote functions.

Article 7 (Rights of Individual Location Information Subjects)
1. Players may withdraw all or part of their consent to the collection, use, and provision of location information at any time. Upon withdrawal of consent, location-based services will be suspended immediately, and the Member may choose account deletion or service suspension.
2. Players may request temporary suspension of the collection, use, and provision of location information at any time, and the Company will provide the technical means and comply immediately.
3. Players may request access to or notification of verification data confirming the collection/use/provision of their location information and history of provision to third parties, and request correction if there are errors.

Article 8 (User-Generated Content (UGC) Policy)
1. All items created by Players in the game, including nicknames and profiles, are classified as User-Generated Content (UGC).
2. The creation of harmful content that is obscene, abusive, defamatory, advertising, or infringes on the rights of others is strictly prohibited.
3. Players can immediately report or block other members' harmful content or inappropriate behavior using the in-app reporting and blocking features.
4. The Company will review and monitor reported harmful content within 24 hours to delete or correct it, and immediately restrict (temporary or permanent suspension) the app usage of the Player who posted it, ensuring a clean service environment.

Article 9 (Obligations of the Company)
1. The Company shall not engage in acts prohibited by relevant laws and these Terms or contrary to public order and morals, and will do its best to provide continuous and stable services.
2. The Company will establish and operate a security system to protect personal and location information so that Players can use the service safely.
3. The Company will process opinions or complaints raised by Players without delay if they are deemed justified.

Article 10 (Obligations and Prohibited Conduct of Players)
Players shall not engage in any of the following acts in connection with the use of the Service:
1. Registering false information by unauthorized copying or stealing of others' email, account information, or device identifier (UUID) during sign-up or profile modification.
2. Transmitting false location coordinates using GPS spoofing software, emulator location manipulation tools, or other abnormal methods to acquire territories without actually visiting the site.
3. Modifying the game client program provided by the Company or manipulating or forging server communication data.
4. Deliberately exploiting errors or bugs in the game to abnormally acquire gold (GP) or induce abnormal territory capture states.

Article 11 (Sanctions and Penalties for Abnormal Play)
1. The Company may apply the following sanctions stepwise or immediately depending on the severity of the violation:
A. Warning: First warning and demand to stop abnormal behavior.
B. Territory confiscation and initialization: All territories acquired through abnormal location spoofing or bug exploitation will be forcibly retrieved without prior notice and reset to neutral territories.
C. Account restriction: Suspending all service use, such as game login and territory capture, for a certain period.
D. Permanent termination and re-registration restriction: If malicious abuse, such as creating or distributing illegal programs or repeated location spoofing, is confirmed, the account will be permanently deleted and the corresponding device identifier will be blocked to prevent re-registration.
2. Players who wish to appeal the sanctions under this Article may submit an appeal via email within 7 days from the date of receiving the notice.

Article 12 (In-App Purchases and Subscription Cancellation)
1. If paid items or in-app purchases are introduced in the game, the Player may request subscription cancellation (purchase cancellation) for unused content within 7 days from the date of purchase.
2. If a minor Player over the age of 14 makes an in-app purchase without the consent of a legal representative, the minor or the legal representative may cancel the payment, unless the minor used deception to make the Company believe they were an adult.
3. In-app purchases and refunds will be processed fairly, with priority given to the policies and refund guidelines of platform open market operators such as Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

Article 13 (In-Game Virtual Assets and Content)
1. 'Gold (GP)' is a free virtual data asset used to maintain territories or run specific modes within the game.
2. Gold (GP) is automatically and systemically accumulated based on registration maintenance, the number of captured territories, and capture duration, and is not a real-world asset.
3. Players are prohibited from selling, transferring, renting, or exchanging in-game data such as Gold (GP) and territories to others for value or converting them into cash.
4. Upon termination of service (account deletion), all Gold (GP) and captured territory data held by the Player will be destroyed and cannot be recovered.

Article 14 (Change and Suspension of Service)
1. The Company may change or temporarily suspend all or part of the services offered due to operational or technical needs, patches for service activation, or system inspections.
2. In the case of system inspections and regular patches, notices will be posted in advance. However, in unavoidable cases such as emergency server failure or hacking incidents, notification may be given post-facto.
3. The Company shall not be liable to the Player for any modification or suspension of the service provided for free, unless otherwise specified by relevant laws.

Article 15 (Indemnification and Disclaimer)
1. The Company is exempt from liability if it cannot provide the service due to force majeure, including natural disasters, war, national emergencies, telecommunications provider line failures, or GPS satellite signal failures.
2. The Company is not liable for failures in territory capture decision, gold accumulation errors, or data delays caused by the Player's individual device performance, settings (location permission denied, battery saver mode, etc.), GPS errors, or poor communication status.
3. Players must fully recognize the nature of the location-based game, which requires physical walking and movement outdoors, and must comply with all safety regulations to prevent hazards. The Company is not liable for any physical injury or accident caused by the Player's own negligence.

Article 16 (Termination and Deletion of Account)
1. Players may apply for termination (deletion) of the service agreement at any time via the 'Delete Account' feature in the game settings menu.
2. Upon account deletion, all hexagon territories captured by the Player will immediately return to neutral status so that other players can freely acquire them, and all virtual assets, record statistics, and collected identification data will be permanently and immediately deleted (Cascade Delete) from the server database and cannot be recovered.

Article 17 (Governing Law and Jurisdiction)
1. These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Korea.
2. Any dispute arising between the Company and the Player in connection with the use of the Service shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the court determined by the Civil Procedure Act of the Republic of Korea.
agreePrivacyDetail:
1. Purpose of Processing Personal Information
The Service processes a minimum amount of personal information for the purposes of member registration, account management, providing location-based services (calculating real-time territory capture and HQ base coordinates), generating in-game rankings, sending real-time push notifications of territory changes, and handling Player complaints.

2. Items of Personal Information Collected and Used
The Company collects the following personal information to provide the Service:
- Collected during sign-up: Email address, unique identifier from external authentication platforms (Google, Apple, etc.), profile nickname.
- Automatically collected and processed: Unique device identifier (UUID), access logs, OS version, and device model info.
- Collected for location-based services: Real-time GPS latitude and longitude coordinate data and movement speed of the Player's device (including background collection when running in background mode).

3. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information
A Player's personal information and territory data will be permanently and immediately deleted (100% Cascade Delete) and the territory will be neutralized upon account deletion.

4. Procedure and Method of Personal Information Destruction
When personal information becomes unnecessary due to expiration of the retention period or achievement of the processing purpose, the Company will destroy it without delay. Electronic files are deleted using technical methods that cannot reproduce the records, and paper documents are shredded or incinerated.

5. Third-Party Provision and Entrustment of Personal Information
The Company entrusts the processing of personal information to professional companies as follows to provide the Service:
- Supabase: Entrusted with providing real-time distributed cloud database infrastructure and data storage/processing (Retention: Destroyed immediately upon account deletion).
- Firebase Cloud Messaging (Google LLC): Entrusted with sending real-time push notifications regarding territory changes and important service events (Retention: Destroyed immediately upon completion of push transmission).

6. Player's Right to Account Deletion & Data Erasure
1. Players have the right to request permanent deletion of their account and complete erasure of collected data at any time via the in-app settings menu (Delete Account) or the designated support email (kydculx@gmail.com).
2. Immediately upon receipt of the deletion request, the Player's personal identification data, gold assets, activity statistics, and captured map territory data will be permanently and immediately deleted (Cascade Delete) and neutralized in the server database, making recovery or reuse absolutely impossible.

7. Rights and Obligations of Information Subjects and Legal Representatives
Players may exercise their rights to request access to, correction of, deletion of, or suspension of processing of their personal information at any time, and the Company will take action without delay upon receipt via email.

8. Installation, Operation, and Rejection of Automatic Personal Information Collection Devices
In principle, the Service does not use or minimizes web browser cookies or advertising identifiers that frequently store and retrieve user information. Players can control collection consent at any time through their device settings.

9. Technical and Administrative Measures to Protect Personal Information
The Company takes the following measures to secure personal information:
- Encryption of personal information: Email addresses are encrypted when stored in the database, and device identifiers are also managed under encryption using non-decryptable hash functions.
- Access control and transmission security: All communications are encrypted and transmitted through SSL/TLS security protocols, and Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) policies are applied to block unauthorized third-party access.

10. Protection of Minors' Personal Information
In principle, the Company does not collect personal information of children under the age of 14. If it is confirmed that personal information of a child under 14 has been collected without the consent of their legal representative, the Company will immediately delete the account and destroy the personal information.

11. Chief Privacy Officer and Inquiry Resolution
Any inquiries or remedies regarding personal information during the use of the Service will be handled through the email below:
- Department and Email: kydculx@gmail.com
- Government agencies for infringement reports: Personal Information Infringement Report Center (privacy.kisa.or.kr)

guideAreaContent: The hexagonal minimum unit dividing the entire world's territory. Each area has unique coordinates, serving as the foundational asset that generates Gold when captured by players.
guideCaptureContent: Empty, unowned areas can be captured quickly. However, areas already owned by another player will require additional capture time proportional to that zone's cumulative capture count.
guideOverviewContent: Dibs Adventure is a real-time location-based capture game utilizing GPS coordinates to explore and capture areas around the entire world.
guideMoveModeContent: Physically move and capture the administrative hexagon tiles directly under your feet. Free of charge and optimal for rapid expansion.
guideRemoteModeContent: Establish remote links via your established Main Base or connected territories. Tap tiles on the map to trigger remote capture, which requires GP and cooldown. Additionally, as the cumulative capture count of a zone increases, the time required for capture will continuously increase.
guideHqContent: The central anchor of all player activities. Links you to Remote Capture. If you change your actual physical location, you can relocate your base in the profile settings.
guideGoldContent: Gold GP accumulates automatically relative to your total captured territories over time. Securing and protecting more land enables larger strategic operations.
guideShieldContent: Upon capturing a zone, a defense shield activates for a limited time to protect your territory from being recaptured by other players.
guideRevealContent: During Remote Capture, you can spend GP to decrypt and reveal hidden security details, such as the zone's owner and shield duration.
guideAlertContent: Receive instant warning push notifications and on-screen alerts if your main base is captured or you lose territory.
guideRankingContent: Check your ranking against other players across various categories: captured tiles, daily moves, and total moves. View your rank and the top 100 statistics.
guideAchievementContent: Unlock achievements by completing various in-game challenges. Earn achievements for total captured tiles, enemy territory captures, movement distance, remote captures, base fortification, and gold accumulation.
guidePatternContent: Arrange your captured territories into specific alphabet letter shapes on the map to unlock special pattern achievements. Check the pattern guide for required tile counts and your progress.
guideRebaseContent: Your main base is the hub of your activities. You can relocate it to your current location by spending gold in the profile menu. Remote captures are based from your main base, and defending surrounding tiles earns fortification achievements.
guideMapStyleContent: Choose between Neon, Dark, and Satellite map styles for the game screen. Each style offers a different visual experience and can be freely changed at any time.
guideNotificationContent: Receive instant push notifications when your territory is captured by another player or your base is at risk. Configure notification preferences in the profile settings menu.
guideBgSetupContent: For seamless territory capture and synchronization even when the screen is off, it is recommended to set location permission to 'Allow all the time' and disable battery optimization for the app.

onboardingWelcomeDesc: Welcome, Adventurer! This game is based on real-time GPS and actual maps, making the entire world your playground! ⚠️ Note that you must create an account and log in to ensure your capture history and footprints are recorded and saved to the server. Let us briefly introduce the key UI elements and a simple game guide.
onboardingGoldDesc: This is your current Gold (GP) amount. Capturing more territories through adventures accelerates your gold accumulation.
onboardingTimerDesc: Time remaining until the daily reset (UTC 00:00). Daily rankings will reset at midnight.
onboardingStepsDesc: Your real-time step count today. Even when the app is running in the background, walking outdoors will automatically capture nearby zones.
onboardingProfileDesc: This is the menu to check your info and settings. Tap to access features like sign out, and terms of service.
onboardingPatternDesc: Capture territories in specific shapes on the map to match patterns.
onboardingMapFollowDesc: Aligns the map to your location or rotates it with the compass sensor. The map direction turns dynamically.
onboardingMapStyleDesc: Toggles the map style (Dark, Satellite). Switch to the mode that fits your preference.
onboardingCompleteDesc: Now it's time to head to the map and expand your territory. Stay safe and enjoy the game!
onboardingRankingDesc: Check real-time rankings based on territory count, daily movement, and total distance.
onboardingAchievementDesc: Review your badges and achievement progress unlocked by completing various adventure goals.
onboardingMapModeToggleDesc:
Changes how the map is displayed. Tapping cycles through each mode.

• Normal Mode: View displaying all territories and items. Tapping a tile displays its zone information or allows remote capture.
• Footprint Mode: View displaying only your recorded footprint paths. Tapping a tile displays its capture record.
• Pattern Mode: View displaying only completed pattern layouts.

⚠️ Auto capture and footprint recording run continuously in the background regardless of the current mode.
onboardingMyLocationDesc: This is the blue arrow pointing to your real-time location. It rotates dynamically to show your compass direction as you move.
onboardingRemoteDesc: You can spend Gold (GP) to aim, scan, and claim remote zones. Your Headquarters (HQ), marked with a flag, can be relocated from the My Info menu, and gold items generate around it daily for you to collect. Also, each zone becomes progressively harder to capture as its capture count increases.
